title: NSGo game mod manifest (version 1)
description: ModManifest describes a mod. Mod authors write it as YAML in a [ManifestFile] (mod.yaml) in the mod's directory; [ParseManifest] reads it and [EncodeManifest] writes it.

manifestVersion.description: ManifestVersion is the schema version of the manifest file. A mod.yaml must state [ManifestVersion]; a manifest built in code may leave it 0, and [EncodeManifest] writes [ManifestVersion].

id.description: ID uniquely identifies the mod, such as com.example.boss-rush.

name.description: Name is the mod's human-readable name.

version.description: Version is the mod's own semantic version, which dependency constraints are checked against.

author.description: Author optionally names the mod's author.

entry.description: Entry is the entry script's slash-separated path relative to the mod's directory.

gameVersion.description: GameVersion optionally constrains the host game versions the mod runs on, such as ">=0.2.0".

capabilities.description: Capabilities lists the built-in game API capabilities the mod requests. In mod.yaml, the capabilities sequence may also contain dotted host capability names (<namespace>.<name>), which [ParseManifest] decodes into [ModManifest.HostCapabilities] and [EncodeManifest] writes after the built-in names in sorted order.

dependencies.description: Dependencies maps the IDs of mods this mod requires to version constraints.
